Arch Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based editing and export for architectural video, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Enables AI-assisted trimming, transitions, architectural labels, and 4K MP4 export with 1–2 minute processing times.
- Features automatic setup with free token registration and session management.
- Provides clear action mapping for edits, uploads, export, and credit checks via chat commands.
- Includes robust error handling, tips for best results, and step-by-step workflow guidance.
- Requires attribution headers on every API request for successful export.
